blocks.zh: 第三章：廠房、設施與設備
blocks.en: Chapter 3: Premises, Installations and Equipment

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives of This Chapter

blocks.zh: 掌握 GDP 對倉儲廠房的設計、隔離、安全與環境控制要求，包括針對假藥與特殊狀態產品的實體隔離強制規定
blocks.en: Understand the GDP requirements for warehouse design, segregation, security and environmental control, including the mandatory physical segregation of falsified medicines and products in special status

blocks.zh: 理解溫度映射（Temperature Mapping）的目的、執行時機及監控設備佈點原則
blocks.en: Understand the purpose of temperature mapping, when it must be performed, and the principles for positioning monitoring devices

blocks.zh: 了解設備管理的四大要素：設計/定位、維護、清潔、校正，以及校正可追溯性要求
blocks.en: Understand the four elements of equipment management: design/location, maintenance, cleaning and calibration, together with the calibration traceability requirement

blocks.zh: 掌握電腦化系統（Computerised Systems）在 GDP 環境中的驗證/確認、資料完整性與備份要求
blocks.en: Understand the requirements for qualification/validation, data integrity and backup of computerised systems in a GDP environment

blocks.zh: 理解確認與驗證（Qualification & Validation）在 GDP 廠房設施中的應用範圍與基於風險的決策邏輯
blocks.en: Understand the scope of qualification and validation in GDP premises and the risk-based decision logic behind it

blocks.zh: 3.1 — Principle / 原則
blocks.en: 3.1 — Principle

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：廠房設施的三個基本屬性
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Three Basic Attributes of Premises

blocks.zh: GDP 3.1 Principle 提出三個基本前提條件：
blocks.en: GDP 3.1 (Principle) sets three basic preconditions:

blocks.zh: 清潔（Clean）： 防止交叉污染與害蟲，維護產品包裝完整性
blocks.en: Clean: prevents cross-contamination and pests, and protects the integrity of product packaging

blocks.zh: 乾燥（Dry）： 防止水分影響產品穩定性（特別是粉末製劑、吸濕性產品）
blocks.en: Dry: prevents moisture from affecting product stability (especially powder formulations and hygroscopic products)

blocks.zh: 溫度控制（Acceptable Temperature Limits）： 確保產品在標示儲存條件下保存，是藥品配銷最核心的品質保障
blocks.en: Acceptable temperature limits: ensures products are kept under their labelled storage conditions; this is the most fundamental quality safeguard in medicinal product distribution

blocks.zh: 「適合且足夠（Suitable and Adequate）」是 GDP 高頻出現的措辭，代表廠房必須同時滿足性質適合（技術規格符合產品要求）與數量足夠（空間、容量能支撐實際作業需求）兩個面向。
blocks.en: "Suitable and adequate" is a phrase that appears very often in GDP. It means the premises must satisfy two aspects at once: suitability in nature (technical specifications meet product requirements) and adequacy in quantity (space and capacity can support actual operational needs).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 藥品倉庫就像一個精密的生命支持系統：
blocks.en: A medicines warehouse is like a precise life-support system:

blocks.zh: 溫度失控 = 缺氧（直接威脅產品效期與安全性）
blocks.en: Temperature out of control = lack of oxygen (a direct threat to product shelf life and safety)

blocks.zh: 潮濕 = 缺水或過多水（影響穩定性）
blocks.en: Humidity = too little or too much water (affects stability)

blocks.zh: 不清潔 = 感染源（污染風險）
blocks.en: Lack of cleanliness = a source of infection (contamination risk)

blocks.zh: 三個條件缺一不可。即便溫度完全正確，若倉庫漏水導致包裝受潮，仍可能造成產品品質問題並觸發 GDP 違規。
blocks.en: None of the three conditions can be dropped. Even if the temperature is perfectly right, a leaking warehouse that dampens the packaging can still cause product quality problems and trigger a GDP non-compliance.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 「Principle」在 GDP 結構中的功能： 每個 GDP 章節開頭的 Principle，相當於該章的「立法目的聲明」。稽查員在評估具體缺失時，會回頭參照 Principle 判斷嚴重性。理解 3.1 的核心意圖，有助於在系統設計時做出符合法規精神的決策。
blocks.en: The function of the "Principle" in the GDP structure: The Principle at the start of each GDP chapter acts as that chapter's "statement of legislative purpose". When assessing a specific deficiency, inspectors refer back to the Principle to judge its seriousness. Understanding the core intent of 3.1 helps you make system design decisions that respect the spirit of the regulation.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 若公司的常溫倉庫面積即將無法負荷業務增長，GDP 如何看待「不足夠（inadequate）」的倉儲容量？可能引發什麼風險？
blocks.en: If the ambient-temperature warehouse is about to run out of space as the business grows, how does GDP view "inadequate" storage capacity? What risks could it create?

blocks.zh: 「乾燥」在 GDP 的倉儲要求中，通常用哪個量化指標來控制？
blocks.en: In GDP storage requirements, which quantitative indicator is normally used to control "dryness"?

blocks.zh: 3.2 — Premises / 廠房
blocks.en: 3.2 — Premises

blocks.zh: 收貨區（Receiving Bay）的設計邏輯（3.2.7）就像醫院的急診分流：
blocks.en: The design logic of the receiving bay (3.2.7) is like triage in a hospital emergency department:

blocks.zh: 病人（貨品）進來先到「分流區（Reception Area）」
blocks.en: Patients (goods) first go to the triage area (reception area)

blocks.zh: 分流區與一般病房（儲存區）實體隔離
blocks.en: The triage area is physically separated from the general wards (storage areas)

blocks.zh: 評估後才能進入對應的病房（正常庫存區、隔離區）
blocks.en: Only after assessment can they enter the appropriate ward (normal stock area, quarantine area)

blocks.zh: 暴雨天不能讓病人淋雨等候——接收月台必須防雨防風
blocks.en: Patients must not be left waiting in the rain during a storm, so the receiving dock must be protected from rain and wind

blocks.zh: 收貨區的核心功能不只是物理空間，更是品質把關的第一道閘門。接收 SOP 必須規範：到貨確認、溫度數據記錄下載、外觀目視檢查、隔離區暫放等步驟。
blocks.en: The core function of the receiving bay is not just physical space; it is the first gate of quality control. The receiving SOP must define the steps: confirmation of the delivery, download of temperature data records, visual inspection, and temporary holding in quarantine.

blocks.zh: 電子隔離（Electronic Segregation）的前提： 3.2.3 允許電子隔離作為實體隔離的替代，但有兩個嚴格前提：(1) 必須提供「等同的安全性（equivalent security）」，(2) 系統必須經過驗證（validated）。這意味著你的 WMS 或 ERP 的電子隔離功能必須有驗證文件（IQ/OQ/PQ），且驗證報告必須涵蓋「隔離功能的可靠性」。
blocks.en: Prerequisites for electronic segregation: 3.2.3 allows electronic segregation as an alternative to physical segregation, but with two strict prerequisites: (1) it must provide "equivalent security", and (2) the system must be validated. This means the electronic segregation function of your WMS or ERP must be backed by validation documents (IQ/OQ/PQ), and the validation report must cover the "reliability of the segregation function".

blocks.zh: 害蟲防治（Pest Control）的稽查重點： 稽查員會要求查看：(1) 害蟲防治計畫（Pest Control Programme）文件、(2) 定期檢查記錄、(3) 承包廠商資格、(4) 任何異常發現的記錄與後續處置。倉庫角落的老鼠夾記錄是常見的稽查查核點。
blocks.en: Inspection focus for pest control: Inspectors will ask to see: (1) the pest control programme document, (2) records of regular inspections, (3) the qualification of the contractor, and (4) records of any abnormal findings and the follow-up actions. Records for the rodent traps in the corners of the warehouse are a common inspection check point.

blocks.zh: 食物飲料禁止令（3.2.11）的管理意義： 這條規定除了防污染，更重要的是防止人員將個人使用的藥品（包括補充品、處方藥）帶入倉儲區，避免與商業藥品混淆的風險。
blocks.en: The management significance of the food and drink prohibition (3.2.11): Besides preventing contamination, this rule matters because it stops personnel from bringing personal medicines (including supplements and prescription drugs) into the storage area, avoiding the risk of mix-up with commercial medicinal products.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 情境： 你的倉庫收到一批客戶投訴可能包裝異常的退貨，懷疑是偽藥。
blocks.en: Scenario: Your warehouse receives a returned batch following a customer complaint about possible packaging abnormalities, and a falsified medicine is suspected.

blocks.zh: 依據 GDP 3.2.4，這批產品應如何處置？電子系統標記「隔離」狀態是否已足夠？
blocks.en: Under GDP 3.2.4, how should this batch be handled? Is an electronic "quarantine" status flag sufficient?

blocks.zh: 隔離區應設置哪些實體控制措施？訪客或非授權人員能否進入？
blocks.en: What physical controls should be put in place in the segregated area? Can visitors or unauthorised personnel enter?

blocks.zh: 這批產品的最終處置決定權屬於誰（參照 Chapter 2）？
blocks.en: Who has the final authority to decide on the disposition of this batch (see Chapter 2)?

blocks.zh: 若公司將倉儲外包給第三方物流廠商，GDP 3.2.2 要求哪些書面文件？第三方廠商是否需要持有獨立的配銷許可？
blocks.en: If the company outsources storage to a third-party logistics provider, what written documents does GDP 3.2.2 require? Does the third-party provider need to hold its own distribution authorisation?

blocks.zh: 訪客進入倉儲區的管理程序（3.2.8）應包含哪些環節？GMP 製造區對訪客的要求與 GDP 倉儲區有何異同？
blocks.en: What steps should the procedure for visitors entering the storage area (3.2.8) include? How do the requirements for visitors in a GMP manufacturing area differ from, or resemble, those in a GDP storage area?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：隔離的法規層級
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Regulatory Hierarchy of Segregation

blocks.zh: GDP 3.2.4 建立了一個重要的「隔離層級」概念：
blocks.en: GDP 3.2.4 establishes an important "segregation hierarchy":

blocks.zh: 關鍵區別：前五類是絕對要求實體隔離（must always be physically segregated）——電子隔離、倉儲管理系統（WMS）的狀態標記、軟體鎖定都不能替代實體隔離。這是 GDP 最嚴格的強制性條款之一。
blocks.en: Key distinction: the first five categories must always be physically segregated. Electronic segregation, status flags in the warehouse management system (WMS) and software locks cannot replace physical segregation. This is one of the strictest mandatory clauses in GDP.

blocks.zh: 3.3 — Temperature and Environment Control / 溫度與環境控制
blocks.en: 3.3 — Temperature and Environment Control

blocks.zh: 核心概念：溫度映射（Temperature Mapping）的邏輯
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Logic of Temperature Mapping

blocks.zh: 溫度映射（Temperature Mapping，簡稱 T-mapping）是 GDP 倉儲管理中最重要的確認活動之一。其核心邏輯是：
blocks.en: Temperature mapping (T-mapping) is one of the most important qualification activities in GDP warehouse management. The core logic is:

blocks.zh: 找出溫度極值點： 倉庫內不同位置的溫度並非均勻分佈，靠近門口、冷氣出風口、地板/天花板等位置會有顯著差異
blocks.en: Find the temperature extremes: Temperature is not evenly distributed across a warehouse; positions near doors, air-conditioning outlets, the floor and the ceiling can differ significantly

blocks.zh: 依結果佈點監控器： 監控點必須放在「最容易超標的位置」，而非「最容易量測的位置」
blocks.en: Position monitors according to the results: Monitoring points must be placed where the limits are most likely to be exceeded, not where measurement is easiest

blocks.zh: 代表性條件（Representative Conditions）： 映射必須在模擬實際作業的條件下執行（例如：夏季、滿倉、門頻繁開關），而非在理想空倉狀態下進行
blocks.en: Representative conditions: Mapping must be performed under conditions that simulate actual operations (for example summer, a fully loaded warehouse, doors opened frequently), not in an ideal empty-warehouse state

blocks.zh: 重新映射的觸發條件（Significant Changes）： 通常包含增建、改建、空調系統更換、最大庫存量變更、監控系統升級等。觸發與否應基於風險評估，並記錄評估結論。
blocks.en: Triggers for re-mapping (significant changes): These normally include extensions, renovations, replacement of the air-conditioning system, changes to the maximum stock level, and upgrades of the monitoring system. Whether re-mapping is triggered should be based on a risk assessment, and the conclusion should be recorded.

blocks.zh: 溫度映射就像在辦公室找「冷熱點」：
blocks.en: Temperature mapping is like looking for the hot and cold spots in an office:

blocks.zh: 冷氣出風口正下方 = 最冷區（可能讓產品過冷）
blocks.en: Directly under the air-conditioning outlet = coldest area (product may be overcooled)

blocks.zh: 窗邊陽光直射處 = 最熱區（可能超出上限）
blocks.en: By a window in direct sunlight = hottest area (the upper limit may be exceeded)

blocks.zh: 中間走道 = 相對穩定區
blocks.en: The central aisle = relatively stable area

blocks.zh: 你不會把體溫計放在最舒適的地方——你要把它放在最極端的地方，這樣才知道倉庫在最壞條件下是否仍然合規。四個監控因素（溫度、光線、濕度、清潔度）中，溫度是最關鍵的，但其他三項在特殊產品（例如光敏感注射劑）中同樣不可忽視。
blocks.en: You would not put the thermometer in the most comfortable spot; you put it in the most extreme spot, so that you know whether the warehouse still complies under the worst conditions. Of the four monitored factors (temperature, light, humidity and cleanliness), temperature is the most critical, but the other three cannot be ignored for special products (for example light-sensitive injectables).

blocks.zh: 「代表性條件（Representative Conditions）」的稽查解讀： 稽查員會審查溫度映射報告中的執行條件描述。若映射是在冬季、空倉、門窗緊閉的理想狀態下進行，而實際作業是夏季最高溫時全力出貨，稽查員可能認為映射結果不具代表性，要求重新執行或補充最差條件（Worst Case）測試。
blocks.en: How inspectors read "representative conditions": Inspectors will review the description of the execution conditions in the temperature mapping report. If the mapping was done in winter, with an empty warehouse and doors and windows closed, while actual operations run at full shipping volume in the peak summer heat, inspectors may consider the results unrepresentative and ask for the study to be repeated or supplemented with worst-case testing.

blocks.zh: 小型常溫倉的彈性規定： GDP 3.3.2 最後一句為小型常溫倉提供了務實的替代方式——不強制全面映射，但必須進行風險評估，並根據評估結果決定監控點位置。這個評估本身必須有書面記錄。
blocks.en: Flexibility for small ambient warehouses: The last sentence of GDP 3.3.2 gives small ambient warehouses a practical alternative: full mapping is not mandatory, but a risk assessment must be performed and the location of monitoring points decided on its outcome. The assessment itself must be documented.

blocks.zh: 一座 2-8°C 冷藏室完成初始溫度映射後，因業務需要將最大庫存量從 500 箱增加至 1,500 箱，是否需要重新映射？如何做出決策並記錄？
blocks.en: A 2-8°C cold room has completed its initial temperature mapping. For business reasons, the maximum stock level is then increased from 500 cartons to 1,500 cartons. Does it need to be re-mapped? How would you make the decision and record it?

blocks.zh: 溫度監控點應放置在最熱點還是最冷點？若這兩個點都超出 2-8°C 的規格（上限 8°C），哪個點的超標風險更高？
blocks.en: Should the temperature monitoring point be placed at the hottest or the coldest spot? If both spots exceed the 2-8°C specification (upper limit 8°C), which one carries the higher risk of excursion?

blocks.zh: 3.4 — Equipment / 設備
blocks.en: 3.4 — Equipment

blocks.zh: 核心概念：GDP 關鍵設備的管理要素
blocks.en: Core Concept: Management Elements for GDP Key Equipment

blocks.zh: GDP 3.4 對關鍵設備（Key Equipment）的管理要求可以拆解為四個維度：
blocks.en: The GDP 3.4 requirements for key equipment can be broken down into four dimensions:

blocks.zh: 設計/定位（Design/Location）： 設備規格與擺放位置必須符合預期使用目的
blocks.en: Design/location: Equipment specifications and placement must suit the intended use

blocks.zh: 維護（Maintenance）： 預防性維護計畫（Planned Maintenance），包含定期保養與零件更換
blocks.en: Maintenance: A planned (preventive) maintenance programme, including routine servicing and parts replacement

blocks.zh: 清潔（Cleaning）： 清潔標準應有文件依據，且不得成為污染源
blocks.en: Cleaning: Cleaning standards should be documented, and cleaning must not become a source of contamination

blocks.zh: 校正（Calibration）： 以風險與可靠性評估為基礎，確定校正間隔，並可追溯至國家/國際標準
blocks.en: Calibration: The calibration interval is determined on the basis of a risk and reliability assessment, and calibration must be traceable to national or international standards

blocks.zh: 3.4.5 列出了「關鍵設備」的具體範例，在 CDMO 配銷環境中尤其需要建立清單並逐一管理。
blocks.en: 3.4.5 lists specific examples of "key equipment". In a CDMO distribution environment in particular, a list should be established and each item managed individually.

blocks.zh: 警報系統（Alarm System）的管理邏輯（3.4.3）類似住宅的煙霧偵測器：
blocks.en: The management logic of the alarm system (3.4.3) is similar to a smoke detector at home:

blocks.zh: 安裝了但從不測試 → 電池沒電時你不會知道，緊急時刻才發現失效
blocks.en: Installed but never tested = you will not know when the battery is dead, and you discover the failure only in an emergency

blocks.zh: 設定閾值太敏感 → 每次開冰箱都觸發假警報，員工習慣性忽略
blocks.en: Threshold set too sensitive = a false alarm every time the refrigerator is opened, and staff learn to ignore it

blocks.zh: 設定閾值太寬鬆 → 產品早已嚴重超標才警告，為時已晚
blocks.en: Threshold set too loose = the warning comes only after the product is already far out of limits, which is too late

blocks.zh: GDP 要求警報門限值「適當設定（appropriately set）」且「定期測試（regularly tested）」。最常見的稽查缺失之一，就是警報設定從未經過正式評估，或警報測試記錄缺失。
blocks.en: GDP requires alarm limits to be "appropriately set" and "regularly tested". One of the most common inspection findings is that the alarm settings were never formally assessed, or that alarm test records are missing.

blocks.zh: 校正可追溯性（Traceability）的法規含義： 校正報告必須顯示校正鏈——從你的設備，到校正實驗室的標準器，再到國家計量標準（如 BSMI 認可實驗室的 TAF 認可）。「不知道校正實驗室是否有 TAF 認可」在 GDP 稽查中是常見發現項目。
blocks.en: The regulatory meaning of calibration traceability: A calibration report must show the calibration chain: from your instrument, to the reference standard of the calibration laboratory, and on to the national metrology standard (for example, TAF accreditation of a laboratory recognised by BSMI). "Not knowing whether the calibration laboratory holds TAF accreditation" is a common finding in GDP inspections.

blocks.zh: 設備失效應急程序（Equipment Failure Procedure）： 3.4.4 要求當設備故障時，必須有程序確保產品完整性不受損。在實務上，冷鏈設備的應急程序應包含：(1) 故障通報流程、(2) 備用設備啟動步驟、(3) 產品轉移的決策流程與時限、(4) 溫度偏差記錄與評估程序。這份程序必須是事前準備好的書面 SOP，不能在故障發生後才臨時擬定。
blocks.en: Equipment failure contingency procedure: 3.4.4 requires a procedure to ensure that product integrity is not compromised when equipment fails. In practice, the contingency procedure for cold chain equipment should include: (1) the failure notification process, (2) the steps for starting up backup equipment, (3) the decision process and time limits for transferring product, and (4) the procedure for recording and evaluating temperature deviations. This must be a written SOP prepared in advance, not something drafted ad hoc after a failure occurs.

blocks.zh: 校正間隔基於風險評估： GDP 3.4.2 刻意不規定固定的校正頻率（如每年一次），而要求廠商依據「風險與可靠性評估（Risk and Reliability Assessment）」決定。這意味著高風險設備（如冷藏室內唯一溫度感測器）可能需要更短的校正間隔，且這個決策必須有文件記錄。
blocks.en: Calibration intervals based on risk assessment: GDP 3.4.2 deliberately does not prescribe a fixed calibration frequency (such as once a year), and instead requires the company to decide on the basis of a "risk and reliability assessment". This means high-risk equipment (such as the only temperature sensor in a cold room) may need a shorter calibration interval, and the decision must be documented.

blocks.zh: 列出你們公司倉儲環境中的「關鍵設備清單」，對照 GDP 3.4.5 的範例，有哪些設備可能被遺漏？
blocks.en: List the "key equipment" in your company's storage environment and compare it with the examples in GDP 3.4.5. Which items might have been missed?

blocks.zh: 冷藏室的溫度記錄器校正間隔應如何用風險評估來決定？哪些因素會讓你縮短校正週期？
blocks.en: How should the calibration interval for a cold room temperature recorder be determined through risk assessment? Which factors would shorten the calibration cycle?

blocks.zh: 若冷藏室在週末故障，你的 SOP 目前規定了什麼？DRP 是否在應急程序中被賦予明確角色？
blocks.en: If a cold room fails over the weekend, what does your SOP currently specify? Is the RP given a clear role in the contingency procedure?

blocks.zh: 3.5 — Computerised Systems / 電腦化系統
blocks.en: 3.5 — Computerised Systems

blocks.zh: 核心概念：GDP 電腦化系統的五大要求
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Five Key Requirements for GDP Computerised Systems

blocks.zh: GDP 3.5 對電腦化系統（Computerised Systems，包含 WMS、ERP、溫度監控軟體等）提出五項核心要求：
blocks.en: GDP 3.5 sets five core requirements for computerised systems (including WMS, ERP and temperature monitoring software):

blocks.zh: 上線前驗證/確認： 必須有文件證明系統能準確、一致、可重現地達成預期功能
blocks.en: Validation/verification before go-live: There must be documented evidence that the system achieves its intended function accurately, consistently and reproducibly

blocks.zh: 系統描述文件（System Description）： 書面、詳細、持續更新，包含安全措施、系統範圍、介接關係
blocks.en: System description: Written, detailed and kept up to date, covering security measures, system scope and interfaces

blocks.zh: 存取控制（Access Control）： 資料只能由被授權的人員輸入或修改
blocks.en: Access control: Data may be entered or modified only by authorised persons

blocks.zh: 資料保護與備份： 防止意外或未授權修改，定期備份，備份保存至少 5 年於獨立安全位置
blocks.en: Data protection and backup: Protection against accidental or unauthorised modification; regular backups; backup data kept for at least 5 years in a separate, secure location

blocks.zh: 故障應急程序： 系統故障時的作業程序，包含資料還原機制
blocks.en: Failure contingency procedure: Operating procedures for system failure, including data recovery mechanisms

blocks.zh: 備份的「異地」要求（3.5.4）類似銀行的異地備援機制：
blocks.en: The "off-site" requirement for backups (3.5.4) is similar to a bank's off-site recovery arrangement:

blocks.zh: 若備份與主系統放在同一棟建築 → 火災時兩者同時損毀
blocks.en: If the backup is kept in the same building as the main system = a fire destroys both at the same time

blocks.zh: 異地（Separate Location）= 實體上分離的位置（不同樓層還不夠，應是不同建築或雲端）
blocks.en: Separate location = a physically separate place (a different floor is not enough; it should be a different building or the cloud)

blocks.zh: 安全位置（Secure Location）= 有存取控制的備份環境，防止未授權取用
blocks.en: Secure location = a backup environment with access control that prevents unauthorised access

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，「5 年」的保存要求意味著必須將備份政策寫入資訊管理 SOP，並定期驗證備份資料的可讀取性（Accessibility）——備份了但無法還原，等同未備份。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the "5 years" retention requirement means the backup policy must be written into the information management SOP, and the accessibility of backup data must be verified regularly. A backup that cannot be restored is the same as no backup.

blocks.zh: 「驗證（Validation）或確認（Verification）」的區別： GDP 3.5.1 同時提及兩個詞，這反映了歐盟藥法對不同規模系統的務實態度。商業套裝軟體（COTS, Commercial Off-The-Shelf）通常進行「確認（Verification）」而非完整的「驗證（Validation）」，重點在確認軟體的設定與使用符合預期功能。自行開發或高度客製化的系統則通常需要完整的 IQ/OQ/PQ 驗證。
blocks.en: The difference between "validation" and "verification": GDP 3.5.1 mentions both terms, which reflects the pragmatic attitude of EU pharmaceutical law towards systems of different scale. Commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software is usually subjected to "verification" rather than full "validation", with the focus on confirming that the configuration and use of the software meet the intended function. In-house developed or highly customised systems normally require full IQ/OQ/PQ validation.

blocks.zh: 資料完整性（Data Integrity）是 21 CFR Part 11 的核心： GDP 3.5.3 和 3.5.4 的要求與 21 CFR Part 11（台灣依據 TFDA 相關規定）的電子記錄/電子簽章要求高度重疊。存取控制、稽核軌跡（Audit Trail）、資料修改記錄等，是稽查中最常被聚焦的領域。
blocks.en: Data integrity is at the heart of 21 CFR Part 11: The requirements of GDP 3.5.3 and 3.5.4 overlap heavily with the electronic records and electronic signatures requirements of 21 CFR Part 11 (in Taiwan, the relevant TFDA provisions). Access control, audit trails and records of data changes are the areas most often focused on in inspections.

blocks.zh: 情境： 公司計畫將現有紙本倉儲管理系統（WMS）升級為雲端 SaaS 系統，並以電子隔離取代部分紙本標籤的實體隔離。
blocks.en: Scenario: The company plans to upgrade its existing paper-based warehouse management system (WMS) to a cloud SaaS system, and to replace the physical segregation by paper labels in some cases with electronic segregation.

blocks.zh: 依據 GDP 3.5.1，上線前需要完成哪些驗證/確認活動？
blocks.en: Under GDP 3.5.1, which validation/verification activities must be completed before go-live?

blocks.zh: 電子隔離功能必須滿足 3.2.3 的「等同安全性」要求——這在驗證計畫中如何設計測試案例？
blocks.en: The electronic segregation function must meet the "equivalent security" requirement of 3.2.3. How would test cases for this be designed in the validation plan?

blocks.zh: 雲端備份是否滿足 3.5.4 的「獨立且安全位置」要求？需要確認哪些合約條款？
blocks.en: Does cloud backup satisfy the "separate and secure location" requirement of 3.5.4? Which contract terms need to be confirmed?

blocks.zh: 3.6 — Qualification and Validation / 確認與驗證
blocks.en: 3.6 — Qualification and Validation

blocks.zh: 核心概念：GDP 確認/驗證的範圍
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Scope of GDP Qualification/Validation

blocks.zh: GDP 3.6 將 GMP 製造環境熟悉的確認/驗證概念引入配銷領域，適用範圍包含：
blocks.en: GDP 3.6 brings the qualification/validation concepts familiar from the GMP manufacturing environment into distribution. The scope includes:

blocks.zh: 儲存（Storage）： 冷藏室、冷凍庫、常溫倉的確認（IQ/OQ/PQ）
blocks.en: Storage: Qualification of cold rooms, freezers and ambient warehouses (IQ/OQ/PQ)

blocks.zh: 揀選與包裝（Pick and Pack）： 確保揀貨程序的準確性與一致性
blocks.en: Pick and pack: Ensuring the accuracy and consistency of the picking process

blocks.zh: 運輸（Transportation）： 冷鏈運輸的驗證（如保冷箱的溫度保持能力）
blocks.en: Transportation: Validation of cold chain transport (for example the temperature-holding capability of insulated shippers)

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則： 確認/驗證的範圍與深度，由文件化的風險評估（Documented Risk Assessment）決定，不是所有設備都需要同等深度的確認。DRP 應主導這個風險評估決策。
blocks.en: Key principle: The scope and depth of qualification/validation are determined by a documented risk assessment; not all equipment needs the same depth of qualification. The RP should lead this risk assessment decision.

blocks.zh: CAPA 在 GDP 報告中的應用
blocks.en: Application of CAPA in GDP Reports

blocks.zh: GDP 3.6.3 要求驗證/確認報告必須：
blocks.en: GDP 3.6.3 requires that a validation/qualification report must:

blocks.zh: 記錄所有觀察到的偏差（Deviations）
blocks.en: Record all deviations observed

blocks.zh: 對偏差提出後續措施（Corrective and Preventive Actions，CAPA）
blocks.en: Propose follow-up actions for the deviations (corrective and preventive actions, CAPA)

blocks.zh: 由「適當人員（Appropriate Personnel）」審核並批准接受
blocks.en: Be reviewed and approved for acceptance by "appropriate personnel"

blocks.zh: 「適當人員」在 GDP 環境中通常指 DRP 或其授權代表。這個批准動作本身就是一個可稽查的記錄點。
blocks.en: In a GDP environment, "appropriate personnel" normally means the RP or their authorised delegate. This approval step is itself an auditable record point.

blocks.zh: 驗證/確認就像新車上路前的安全檢測：
blocks.en: Validation/qualification is like a safety inspection before a new car goes on the road:

blocks.zh: 使用前確認（Before Commencing Use）： 新車出廠前的 PDI（Pre-Delivery Inspection）——確認各功能正常
blocks.en: Before commencing use: The PDI (pre-delivery inspection) before a new car leaves the factory confirms that all functions work properly

blocks.zh: 重大變更後再確認： 發生重大事故維修後需要重新驗車——大修後的冷藏室同理需要重新確認
blocks.en: Re-qualification after significant changes: After major accident repairs the car must be inspected again; likewise, a cold room needs re-qualification after a major overhaul

blocks.zh: 偏差不代表失敗： 驗車發現剎車間距略長 → 調整後重測 → CAPA 閉環。GDP 也接受「有偏差但已 CAPA」的驗證結論，重要的是過程被誠實記錄
blocks.en: Deviations do not mean failure: The inspection finds the braking distance slightly long, so it is adjusted and retested, and the CAPA loop is closed. GDP also accepts a validation conclusion of "deviations found but CAPA completed"; what matters is that the process is recorded honestly

blocks.zh: 「維修後重新確認」是常見忽略項目： GDP 3.6.2 明確列出「維修或保養（repair or maintenance）」是觸發重新確認的重大變更之一。在實務上，冷藏室更換壓縮機或溫控控制器後，必須評估是否需要重新執行 OQ/PQ，即使設備規格看起來完全相同。這個評估本身也需要有書面記錄。
blocks.en: "Re-qualification after repair" is a commonly overlooked item: GDP 3.6.2 explicitly lists "repair or maintenance" as one of the significant changes that trigger re-qualification. In practice, after the compressor or temperature controller of a cold room is replaced, you must assess whether OQ/PQ needs to be repeated, even if the equipment specification appears identical. This assessment must also be documented.

blocks.zh: 風險評估決定範圍是 GDP 相對於 GMP 的務實之處： GDP 並未要求所有配銷設備都做完整的 IQ/OQ/PQ，而是允許廠商透過風險評估決定哪些設備需要確認、確認的深度為何。這給了 CDMO 一定的靈活性，但也要求決策的透明性與可追溯性。
blocks.en: Letting risk assessment determine the scope is where GDP is more pragmatic than GMP: GDP does not require full IQ/OQ/PQ for all distribution equipment; it allows companies to decide through risk assessment which equipment needs qualification and to what depth. This gives a CDMO some flexibility, but it also demands that decisions be transparent and traceable.

blocks.zh: 一個新採購的保冷箱（Thermal Shipper）用於 2-8°C 產品的最後一哩配送，GDP 3.6 要求如何對它進行驗證？驗證方案應設計哪些測試條件（最差條件）？
blocks.en: A newly purchased thermal shipper is to be used for last-mile delivery of 2-8°C products. How does GDP 3.6 require it to be validated? Which test conditions (worst case) should the validation protocol include?

blocks.zh: 公司現有的 DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ 文件架構適用於 GMP 製造設備，在 GDP 倉儲確認中，這個架構需要做哪些調整？
blocks.en: The company's existing DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ document structure was built for GMP manufacturing equipment. What adjustments does this structure need for GDP warehouse qualification?

blocks.zh: 若驗證報告顯示冷藏室某個角落在最差條件下溫度達到 9°C（超出 8°C 上限），這算「驗證失敗」嗎？應如何處理？
blocks.en: If a validation report shows that one corner of the cold room reaches 9°C under worst-case conditions (exceeding the 8°C upper limit), does this count as a "validation failure"? How should it be handled?

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 廠房基本要求： 清潔、乾燥、溫度受控是三個不可妥協的基本條件；「適合且足夠」同時覆蓋品質適合性與容量充足性
blocks.en: Basic requirements for premises: Clean, dry and temperature-controlled are three non-negotiable conditions; "suitable and adequate" covers both quality suitability and sufficient capacity

blocks.zh: 實體隔離是強制要求： 偽造藥品、過期、召回、拒收、未授權產品必須物理隔離，電子系統隔離不能取代——這是 GDP 最剛性的合規要求之一
blocks.en: Physical segregation is mandatory: Falsified, expired, recalled, rejected and unauthorised products must be physically segregated, and electronic segregation cannot replace this; it is one of the most rigid compliance requirements in GDP

blocks.zh: 溫度映射為監控點選擇的基礎： 必須在代表性條件下執行，監控器佈點在溫度極值區；重大變更後需評估是否重新映射
blocks.en: Temperature mapping is the basis for selecting monitoring points: It must be performed under representative conditions, with monitors placed at the temperature extremes; after significant changes, assess whether re-mapping is needed

blocks.zh: 設備管理四要素： 設計/定位 + 預防性維護 + 清潔 + 校正（可追溯至國家標準）；警報閾值應適當設定並定期測試
blocks.en: The four elements of equipment management: design/location + preventive maintenance + cleaning + calibration (traceable to national standards); alarm thresholds should be appropriately set and regularly tested

blocks.zh: 電腦化系統要求上線前驗證，需有系統描述文件、存取控制、防篡改資料保護，備份資料保存至少 5 年於異地安全位置，並備有故障應急程序
blocks.en: Computerised systems require validation before go-live, with a system description, access control and tamper-proof data protection; backup data must be kept for at least 5 years in a separate, secure location, and a failure contingency procedure must be in place

blocks.zh: 確認與驗證範圍由風險評估決定，涵蓋儲存、揀選包裝、運輸等配銷流程；重大變更（含維修）後需重新評估是否需再確認；所有偏差需 CAPA 閉環並由適當人員批准
blocks.en: The scope of qualification and validation is determined by risk assessment and covers distribution processes such as storage, pick and pack, and transportation; after significant changes (including repair), assess whether re-qualification is needed; all deviations must be closed out through CAPA and approved by appropriate personnel
